youtube.baslik: How many frequency bands are enough to understand speech in quiet? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: In 1995, Shannon and colleagues showed that people with normal hearing largely understood speech in quiet from the envelope of only four bands; this finding explains why a cochlear implant can convey speech even with a small number of channels. For the perception of melody and pitch, however, temporal fine structure is decisive, and implants convey it only partly.
